hero.title: About SIV Cleaning
hero.subtitle: Delivering exceptional commercial and facility cleaning across Melbourne South East

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To deliver consistently superior, reliable, and hygienic cleaning services that create healthy, productive, and inviting spaces for businesses, educators, and healthcare providers across Melbourne.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be recognized as Melbourne's most trusted, conscientious, and detail-oriented commercial cleaning partner, setting the benchmark for environmental care, safety, and client satisfaction.

story.title: Let's Make You Fresher Than Ever
story.subtitle: A story of relentless dedication to clean and healthy workplaces
paragraphs: SIV Cleaning was founded with a singular focus: to elevate commercial cleaning standards across Melbourne's rapidly growing south-eastern suburbs. We recognized that businesses were frustrated with inconsistent contract cleaners who cut corners, skipped inspections, and failed to communicate.

We believe in quality and understand that every workplace has distinct sanitization demands. A pediatric clinic requires different protocol than an engineering firm or a bustling kindergarten. That is why we personally inspect each site before crafting a dedicated checklist.

Today, our team of police-checked and insured cleaning specialists looks after offices, kindergartens, medical practices, and aged care centres. We combine industrial-grade equipment with hospital-approved disinfectants and eco-friendly options to guarantee spotless results every single day.

values.title: Reliability & Punctuality
values.description: We show up on time, every time, following strict schedules so your staff never walks into an unserviced workspace.

values.title: Uncompromising Hygiene
values.description: From touchpoints and sanitisation to deep floor scrubbing, we eliminate pathogens and allergens systematically.

values.title: Integrity & Security
values.description: All staff are police cleared and supervised. Your confidential files, expensive tech, and facility security are guarded.

values.title: Clear Communication
values.description: Regular site manager check-ins and an open feedback loop ensure any special requests are addressed immediately.
